node_7.subject: Denise Brooks
node_7.description: This is Denise Brooks's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 6:00 am, open the shop and prepare for the day at 8:00 am, greet and assist early customers from 9:00 am to 11:00 am, have a lunch break at 12:00 pm, engage with more customers and discuss the datacenter proposal from 1:00 pm to 3:00 pm, take a short break and restock items from 3:00 pm to 3:30 pm, continue to assist customers and gather opinions on the datacenter from 3:30 pm to 5:00 pm, begin closing procedures and tidy up the shop from 5:00 pm to 6:00 pm.
